name: Parallax 3D Carousel
description: Draggable 3D ring carousel of image cards that rotates around a vertical axis, with inner image parallax shifting as the ring turns and hover focus that dims the other cards.
contents: Ring of cards, each with a tag chip, image, title and meta line
Accent dot on each card that lights up on hover
behavior: Cards fly in from below with a staggered expo ease on mount
Drag or swipe horizontally to rotate the ring with eased motion
Card background images shift as the ring rotates for a parallax effect
Hovering a card enlarges it and dims the others
editableByProps: Number of cards and their tag, title, meta and image
Card size, ring radius, perspective and intro duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card surface colors and text colors

fixed: Root fills the viewport height with its own background color
Drag uses pointer events and disables touch scrolling on the component
Hover dimming needs a pointer, touch users can only drag
